chain.text: The clinic serves 4,200 registered patients and runs 6 consultation rooms. Opening hours are 08:00 to 19:00 on weekdays and 09:00 to 13:00 on Saturday. Twelve nurses work in three shifts, plus four administrative staff. The clinic's accreditation dates from April 2022 and expires in April 2027. Renewal requires an audit of infection-control records. Attendance averages 180 consultations a day, peaking at 310 in January 2025. The no-show rate is 9 percent, down from 14 percent after September 2024 reminder texts. A March 2024 vaccine fridge failure cost 2,100 euros of stock. The fridge now has a networked temperature alarm and a paper log. In November 2024 a record was updated twice and the allergy field overwritten. Records now lock while open. Prescriptions require a consultation within twelve months. Vaccine stock is counted twice weekly. Excursions above 8 degrees are reported same-day. A second ultrasound machine was postponed in June
